reason: A settings-based utility that enables, disables, stores, and tests an HTTPS and SSH proxy for GitHub Git operations.

summaries.zh: 在 Web UI 中配置、测试和切换 GitHub Git 操作使用的 HTTPS 与 SSH 代理。
summaries.en: A Web UI utility for configuring, testing, and toggling HTTPS and SSH proxies for GitHub Git operations.

capabilities: Configures GitHub HTTPS proxy settings in global Git configuration
Edits the user SSH configuration for GitHub ProxyCommand entries
Tests network connectivity to GitHub through the configured proxy
